title: Saturday Cooking Class
story: Tania takes a cooking class every Saturday in Chattogram. Chef Karim teaches the class. Her classmates are Joy, who can hardly cook, and Mrs. Sultana, who makes wonderful pitha. After class, they often eat at a small restaurant nearby.
storyBn: তানিয়া প্রতি শনিবার চট্টগ্রামে একটি রান্নার ক্লাসে যায়। শেফ করিম ক্লাসটি নেন। তার সহপাঠী জয় প্রায় কিছুই রাঁধতে পারে না, আর মিসেস সুলতানা চমৎকার পিঠা বানান। ক্লাসের পরে তারা প্রায়ই কাছের একটি ছোট রেস্তোরাঁয় খায়।

units.focus: Describe the class, tastes and eating habits
units.focusBn: ক্লাস, স্বাদ ও খাওয়ার অভ্যাস বর্ণনা করা

sessions.pattern: Subject + verb(s) ... / Subject + am, is, are + ...
sessions.tipBn: নিয়মিত কাজ, অভ্যাস ও পছন্দ বোঝাতে present simple হয়; he/she/it-এর পরে verb-এ s/es বসে।

items.en: The class starts at ten o'clock on Saturdays.
Chef Karim always washes his hands before cooking.
Joy loves spicy food but hates bitter vegetables.
Mrs. Sultana makes the best pitha in Chattogram.
Fresh coriander gives the dal a lovely smell.
We usually eat lunch together after class.

sessions.pattern: Subject + don't / doesn't + verb ... / Subject + isn't, aren't + ...
sessions.tipBn: না-বোধক বাক্যে verb-এর আগে don't/doesn't বসে এবং verb মূল রূপে থাকে।

items.en: The class doesn't start before ten o'clock.
Chef Karim doesn't touch food with dirty hands.
Joy doesn't eat bitter gourd at all.
Tania doesn't like too much oil in her food.
This knife isn't sharp enough.
We don't go home right after class.

sessions.pattern: Do / Does + subject + verb ...? / Is, Are + subject + ...?
sessions.tipBn: Do/Does বা Is/Are শুরুতে বসিয়ে হ্যাঁ/না প্রশ্ন হয়; Does-এর পরে verb-এ s বসে না।

items.en: Does the class start at ten o'clock?
Does Joy like very spicy food?
Does Mrs. Sultana make pitha every winter?
Do you peel the potatoes first?
Is the frying pan hot enough?
Do you usually eat lunch together?

sessions.tipBn: অবাক হয়ে বা নিশ্চিত হতে প্রশ্নের শুরুতে Don't, Doesn't, Isn't বা Aren't বসে।

items.en: Don't you like spicy food?
Doesn't Joy know how to boil an egg?
Isn't this dal a little too salty?
Doesn't the class start at ten o'clock?
Aren't these knives very sharp?
Don't you wash the rice before cooking?

sessions.pattern: Wh- word + do / does + subject + verb ...? / Wh- word + is, are ...?
sessions.tipBn: প্রশ্নশব্দের পরে do/does বসে, তারপর subject ও verb-এর মূল রূপ আসে।

items.en: What time does the cooking class start?
Why does Chef Karim add sugar to the curry?
How do you make the dal so tasty?
Which spices do you need for fish curry?
Who washes the pots after class?
How often do you eat out?

units.focus: Describe the busy class and the restaurant right now
units.focusBn: এই মুহূর্তের ক্লাস ও রেস্তোরাঁর দৃশ্য বর্ণনা করা

sessions.tipBn: এই মুহূর্তে বা আজকাল চলছে এমন কাজ বোঝাতে am/is/are + verb-ing হয়।

items.en: Chef Karim is showing us how to fry fish.
Tania is chopping onions very slowly.
Joy is stirring the dal with a wooden spoon.
The oil is heating up in the pan.
We are waiting for our food at the restaurant.
The waiter is bringing three cups of tea.

sessions.pattern: Subject + am / is / are + not + verb-ing ...
sessions.tipBn: am/is/are-এর পরে not বসিয়ে চলমান কাজের না-বোধক বাক্য হয়।

items.en: Tania isn't chopping the garlic yet.
Joy isn't stirring the dal properly.
The oil isn't getting hot enough.
Mrs. Sultana isn't cooking today because she is sick.
The waiter isn't listening to our order.
We aren't eating much fried food these days.

sessions.tipBn: am/is/are শুরুতে বসিয়ে এখন চলমান কাজ নিয়ে প্রশ্ন করা হয়।

items.en: Is Chef Karim showing you how to fry fish?
Are you chopping the onions for the salad?
Is the oil heating up?
Is the rice cooker working properly?
Are you waiting for a table?
Is the waiter bringing our tea now?

sessions.pattern: Wh- word + am / is / are + subject + verb-ing?
sessions.tipBn: প্রশ্নশব্দের পরে am/is/are, তারপর subject ও verb-ing বসে।

items.en: What is Chef Karim cooking today?
Why are your eyes watering?
How much water are you adding to the rice?
Who is making tea for the class?
What are you ordering for lunch?
Which dish are you trying first?

units.focus: Talk about last week's class and a kitchen mistake
units.focusBn: গত সপ্তাহের ক্লাস আর রান্নাঘরের একটি ভুল নিয়ে কথা বলা

sessions.tipBn: অতীতে শেষ হওয়া কাজ বোঝাতে verb-এর past রূপ বসে, যেমন burned, forgot, brought।

items.en: Last Saturday, we learned to cook chicken curry.
Joy burned the rice at the bottom of the pot.
Tania forgot to add salt to the dal.
Chef Karim tasted the curry and smiled.
Mrs. Sultana brought homemade pitha for everyone.
After class, we ordered kebabs at the restaurant.

sessions.pattern: Subject + didn't + verb (base) ... / Subject + wasn't, weren't + ...
sessions.tipBn: অতীতের না-বোধক বাক্যে didn't-এর পরে verb মূল রূপে থাকে।

items.en: We didn't learn to cook beef last Saturday.
Joy didn't watch the pot carefully.
Tania didn't taste the dal before serving it.
The chicken wasn't fully cooked.
Nobody finished Joy's spicy curry.
We didn't leave a tip at the restaurant.

sessions.pattern: Did + subject + verb (base) ...? / Was, Were + subject + ...?
sessions.tipBn: Did শুরুতে বসিয়ে অতীতের প্রশ্ন হয়, আর verb মূল রূপে থাকে।

items.en: Did you learn to cook chicken curry last Saturday?
Did Joy burn the rice again?
Did Chef Karim like your curry?
Did Mrs. Sultana bring pitha for everyone?
Were the kebabs juicy?
Did you follow the recipe step by step?

sessions.tipBn: অবাক হলে বা নিশ্চিত হতে চাইলে Didn't, Wasn't বা Weren't দিয়ে প্রশ্ন শুরু হয়।

items.en: Didn't you add salt to the dal?
Didn't Joy turn off the stove?
Wasn't the chicken curry delicious?
Didn't Chef Karim tell you to soak the rice?
Weren't you hungry after class?
Didn't we order two plates of kebabs?

sessions.tipBn: প্রশ্নশব্দের পরে did বসে, আর verb মূল রূপে থাকে।

items.en: What did you cook in class last week?
How did Joy burn the rice?
Why did you add so much chili?
Who brought the pitha last Saturday?
How much did the kebabs cost?
Where did you learn this recipe?

units.focus: Plan the pitha festival and the Eid menu
units.focusBn: পিঠা উৎসব ও ঈদের খাবারের পরিকল্পনা করা

sessions.pattern: Subject + am / is / are + going to + verb (base) ...
sessions.tipBn: আগে থেকে ঠিক করা পরিকল্পনা বা চোখে দেখা লক্ষণ থেকে ভবিষ্যৎ বোঝাতে going to + verb-এর মূল রূপ বসে।

items.en: Our class is going to cook for the pitha festival.
Mrs. Sultana is going to teach us steamed pitha.
Tania is going to make sweet vermicelli for Eid.
Joy is going to practice cooking rice at home.
Look at that smoke! The pitha is going to burn.
We are going to invite our families to the festival.

sessions.pattern: Subject + am / is / are + not + going to + verb (base) ...
sessions.tipBn: am/is/are-এর পরে not বসিয়ে going to-এর না-বোধক বাক্য হয়।

items.en: Our class isn't going to sell the pitha.
Tania isn't going to use much sugar.
Joy isn't going to cook alone this time.
We aren't going to order food from outside.
The guests aren't going to leave hungry.
Don't worry, the pitha isn't going to burn.

sessions.pattern: Am / Is / Are + subject + going to + verb (base) ...?
sessions.tipBn: am/is/are শুরুতে বসিয়ে কারো পরিকল্পনা নিয়ে প্রশ্ন করা হয়।

items.en: Is our class going to cook for the festival?
Is Mrs. Sultana going to teach us steamed pitha?
Are you going to make sweet vermicelli for Eid?
Are we going to need more rice flour?
Is Chef Karim going to judge the dishes?
Are we going to invite our families?

sessions.pattern: Wh- word + am / is / are + subject + going to + verb (base)?
sessions.tipBn: প্রশ্নশব্দের পরে am/is/are, তারপর subject ও going to + verb বসে।

items.en: What are you going to cook for Eid?
Which pitha is Mrs. Sultana going to make?
How many guests are you going to invite?
Who is going to wash all the pots?
When are you going to start cooking?
How is Joy going to carry all that food?
